Although the focus this week is on the iOS 27 public beta, Apple has also released a new public beta firmware update for AirPods. This update finally brings a long-awaited feature to supported AirPods models: custom equalizer.

AirPods Public Beta Details

The AirPods public beta firmware version is 9.0.314, with build number 9A314b. The following AirPods models are eligible for the update:

  • AirPods Pro 3
  • AirPods Pro 2 (Lightning and USB-C versions)
  • AirPods 4
  • AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation)
  • AirPods Max 2

You can sign up for the AirPods public beta program through the Settings app on your iPhone. After connecting your AirPods, you'll see a toggle in the Settings app to enable the beta firmware. Thereafter, as long as your AirPods are in their charging case and within range of the paired iPhone, the beta will download and install automatically.

  • Open the Settings app
  • Tap on "Bluetooth"
  • Tap the (i) icon next to your AirPods
  • Scroll down and enable "AirPods Beta Updates"

Custom Equalizer Lands on AirPods

After installing the AirPods public beta, a long-awaited new feature will appear in the Settings app: custom equalizer.

With the new custom equalizer controls, you can fine-tune the sound of your AirPods more precisely. In the Settings app, you can adjust the bass, mid, and treble of your AirPods.

Apple notes: "AirPods are designed and made by Apple to faithfully reproduce the sound of music, TV shows, movies, and calls. If you prefer a different sound profile, you can also customise how your AirPods perform when playing any audio."

When adjusting the custom equalizer, you can play songs from Apple Music directly within the Settings app to hear the effects of your adjustments in real time.

This is by no means the most professional equalizer feature on the market—just basic three-band adjustment. However, for AirPods users, this is a long-awaited feature, and Apple has finally relented and made it available to everyone—although most people will likely stick with the default settings.

You can find the new custom equalizer feature under the "Audio & Routing" menu in your AirPods settings within the Settings app. This feature is available for all AirPods equipped with the H2 chip, including AirPods Pro 2, AirPods Pro 3, AirPods 4, and AirPods Max 2.

Other New Features iOS 27 Brings to AirPods

Below are other new features iOS 27 brings to AirPods:

  • Redesigned Settings App: iOS 27 has redesigned the AirPods interface in the Settings app, organising various controls into categories such as Hearing Health, Find My, Live Translation, and more.
  • Adaptive Audio Slider: The Settings app now includes a slider for more granular control over Adaptive Audio mode.
  • GymKit: Although GymKit has been available for several years, it has always required an Apple Watch. As my colleague Zac pointed out, iOS 27 brings the full GymKit experience to the iPhone and AirPods Pro 3.
  • Precision Finding: You can now precisely locate your AirPods Pro 3 within the Find My app on your Apple Watch.
  • Siri AI: When paired with a supported iPhone, AirPods can interact with Siri AI.

Wrapping Up

Which AirPods new feature are you most looking forward to trying? Will you give the new custom equalizer a go? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
